context: Replace the implicit table selection in _export_all_unlocked with an explicit ALLOWLIST constant (items domain: items + its child tables + deferrals + events). Add a pinning test asserting (a) every allowlisted table is exported, (b) no table outside the allowlist ever appears in export output — written so any future 'finding%' table fails the test by construction, before such tables exist. Add events to the export payload (already in TRANSFER_TABLES, so restore compat exists). Correct the workflow header claim. Assert the standalone lossless path is excluded from repo commits or remains disabled (TODO_DB_PACKAGE_VERSION unset) with a workflow-level guard note.
description: CRITICAL-path gate (review finding C1): .github/workflows/todo-db-export.yml runs weekly, git-adds _project/todo-db-export/ (workflow :224) and auto-merges a PR into develop (:287); .gitignore:103-105 force-tracks that directory as a 'provenance trail'. If findings tables land in the shared DB with no export boundary, the next Sunday 09:00 UTC run commits finding content into Git with no human in the loop — silently violating the out-of-Git requirement. This phase pins the boundary BEFORE phase 3 puts findings tables in production. Second, independent fix bundled here (review finding M3): the in-repo export omits the events audit table entirely — _export_all_unlocked (todo_db.py:1770-1823) never reads events even though TRANSFER_TABLES (:650-662) includes it — while the workflow header (:200-203) overclaims 'hash-chained audit events' (true only for the gated standalone-package path; in-repo log_event :959-969 is a plain autoincrement, not hash-chained).

anti_patterns.dont: Defer this phase until after the findings schema lands
anti_patterns.instead: Phase 3 depends on this phase; enforce via tracker deps
anti_patterns.why: One weekly cron tick between schema-in-prod and boundary-merged commits finding content to develop via auto-merge

anti_patterns.dont: Filter finding tables out by name-prefix blocklist
anti_patterns.instead: Explicit allowlist; unknown tables fail closed in the pinning test
anti_patterns.why: A blocklist silently admits any future table someone forgets to list; the leak reappears
